ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to distal tip clusters and sparse surface scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity dark field across the major surface of both lobes. High-contrast white/yellowish pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes. Scattered low-magnitude white punctate spots visible in the central-right region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography; the right lobe trailing edge contains deep concave indentations (notches), while the left lobe trailing edge displays a more continuous, micro-serrated profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves tapering from the central notch to the distal tips with a significant posterior sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) present at the extreme distal tips and along portions of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake-like scratches) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch/tissue loss located on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the tip, associated with heavy barnacle clustering.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical midline crease extending from the median notch toward the peduncle.
